# Blazium Games

> Blazium Games is the platform for playing and publishing games, applications, mods, and assets.

## The platform

- [Blazium Games](https://blazium.games/): Play and publish games, applications, mods, and assets.
- [Introduction](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/intro): What the platform is and where to start.

## MCP and the player server

- [MCP](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/mcp): The developer server for pages, builds, analytics, and keys. A token belongs to this server or the player server, not both.
- [Player MCP](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/mcp/player): The player server for search, reviews, friends, installs, and purchases. Buys go here.

## Listings

- [Listings](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/listings): Taxonomy, the listing check, image sizes, search, and shelves.

## Payments

- [Payments](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/payments): Selling, buying, the balance, cash-outs, and refunds.

## Public API and the editor asset library

- [Public API reference](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/api-reference): Authentication, the envelope, error codes, and rate limits. OpenAPI 3.1 at https://api.blazium.online/api/v1/public/openapi.json.
- [Editor asset library](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/editor-asset-library): The Godot and Blazium AssetLib repository URL, https://api.blazium.online/api/v1/public/asset-library, with optional player sign-in.
- [Anonymous downloads](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/anonymous-downloads): Downloading free projects without an account, and its trade-offs.
- [Download analytics](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/download-analytics): Download sources, access, clients, outcomes, and what is recorded.

## Deploy and crash reporting

- [Deploy builds](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/deploy): Upload builds and symbols from CI.
- [Crash reporting](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/crash-reporting): Crashes and events from a game.

## SEO and discovery

- [SEO and indexing](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/seo-and-indexing): What may be indexed, sitemaps, and share titles.
- [Discovery files](https://blazium-games.github.io/games_docs/docs/discovery): robots.txt, sitemaps, security.txt, the API catalog, and llms.txt.

## Legal and support

- [Privacy Policy](https://blazium.games/privacy-policy): What is collected and how accounts are deleted.
- [Terms of Service](https://blazium.games/terms-of-service): Terms for using Blazium Games.
- [Support](https://blazium.games/support): How to get help.
- [Service status](https://status.blazium.games/): Current status and incidents.
